description: The groups of a space (docs/spec/groups.md): the stored checks, the drawn rectangles, the group commands and their refusals, the rectangle operations and the drop resolution. A case reads its layout, the stored form {state, leader, lastCard} whose state is the tree of the grid with the group cards as boxes, with the options gap, minSize, head, the size of the plane and for a drop band, bandMargin and strip, the height of the tab strip of a content card, then runs its steps; a case with throws refuses its layout with that text, which the reader of projects.json prefixes with the project and the space. A step runs call with args and returns its result or throws its text. create, split, close, dissolve, rename, leader and move are the commands core.group.create, core.card.split, core.card.close, core.group.dissolve, core.group.rename, core.group.leader and core.card.move without tabs, add is the add of a card to a group card, balance is core.layout.balance, and boundary is core.boundary.move with axis, line and position; grid returns xs, ys and the cards of the grid in the order of the tree; stored returns state, leader and lastCard; rect returns the drawn rectangle of a card; path returns the group path of core.card.get; level returns the level of a card; drop returns the target that a drop at a point resolves to, of a tab or with moving group of a group card, whose tab strip is part of the body of its card, {kind, target, side, band, of} of an add and {kind, card} of a tab strip and of a centre, and drag returns the target at the last point of a drag through its points in order, whose anchor is the band where the drag entered the line. A value in a refusal text is its JSON text.
